title: runstate's maintenance control test fails on Apple git hosts (pre-existing, unrelated to this tick)
body: TestTheStoresFetchStartsNoMaintenanceInTheRepositoryItWritesTo (internal/runstate/maintenance_test.go) arms `maintenance.loose-objects.enabled=true` and asserts a plain `git fetch` starts auto maintenance as its control fixture. On this host (git 2.50.1, Apple Git-155) the control fetch starts no maintenance, so the test fails even on the pristine base commit 08589877b6fd with my changes stashed — verified directly. The test's own comment says CI's git is 2.55, so CI presumably passes; the defect is that the control is host-git-version-dependent, which makes `make test` (the full non-short suite) unrunnable-to-red on macOS hosts and weakens the 'full suite passes' evidence any local tick can produce. A version-independent trigger for the control (e.g. `git maintenance run --auto` directly, or a skip keyed to the observed behaviour) would make the fixture prove what it claims everywhere.
